description: This file is a shell script designed as a test suite for verifying the behavior of the 'git p4' integration, specifically testing 'p4 rename' functionality, file copy detection, how renames are handled with different configurations, and the handling of move permissions set via 'p4 configure'. It includes setup steps, various test cases with expectations, and configuration checks.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce server daemon for testing purposes.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the local git repository after tests.
